# 金光明經文句記

**ID:** T1786
**Volume:** T39
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經疏部
**Byline:** 宋 知禮述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 1027
**Juans:** 6
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1786

## Contributors
- 知禮 (A000756)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T1786, paired with [T1784](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305), is [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s subcommentary on the *wénjù* leg of Zhìyǐ's *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* commentarial doublet — that is, on [T1785](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306). Six fascicles in the Taishō, but several Sòng-period lists give 12 fascicles (the CANWWW catalogue records 12巻); the disparity reflects the customary East Asian division-into-halves of the longer *jì*, with the Taishō having absorbed the half-units back into single fascicles.

**Abstract**

Composed contemporaneously with [T1784](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305) in the late 1010s during 知禮's residence at the Yánqìngsì 延慶寺 (Sìmíng), in the same polemical context against the *shānwài* tradition. T1786 is widely regarded as the more philologically detailed of [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* subcommentaries, since the *wénjù* genre demands phrase-by-phrase fidelity to the source where the *xuányì* leg can be programmatic.

A central concern is the treatment of the Bodhisattva *Guāngmíng* 光明 (Golden-Light) cycle's Jātaka chapters — *Liúshuǐ zhǎngzhězǐ pǐn* (chapter 16) and *Shěshēn pǐn* (chapter 17) — which the *shānwài* tradition had read as parable-only, but which [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) argues function simultaneously on all four levels of the Tiāntái grid (因緣, 約教, 本迹, 觀心). The reading became canonical in subsequent Tiāntái exegesis and shaped the Tendai liturgical reception of these narratives in Heian Japan.

Related canonical texts: parent commentary [KR6i0306](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306) (金光明經文句 / T1785); paired subcommentary [KR6i0305](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305) (金光明經玄義拾遺記 / T1784).
